changelog:
Initial release of Kameo AI skill—generate lifelike talking-head videos from static images.

- Convert a single portrait or avatar photo into a 5-second video with realistic facial expression, lip-sync, and motion
- Supports prompt-driven scene customization for enhanced expressions and gestures (basic to advanced prompts)
- Choose video aspect ratios: 9:16, 16:9, or 1:1
- Bash scripts and API instructions provided for simple video generation, credits management, and registration
- Includes best practices, troubleshooting, and detailed usage guidance
summary: Generate expressive talking-head videos from static images using Kameo AI. Converts static avatars/portraits into dynamic 5-second videos with realistic facial expressions, lip-sync, and motion. Use when you need to bring static images to life, create AI character videos, demonstrate visual communication, or generate talking avatars from photos.
